title: Sam Morgan's band and its members
summary: Sam Morgan played for Maison Blanche; Howard lists his band members and notes no piano was used.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: During that time. Sam Morgan, he played at Mise en Blanche in the stores, then he used to play on the truck, which I took part of it later on in the years, you know? Played on the truck, advertised for Mise en Blanche, and it.
Do you remember who played with Manuel Perez in those years? I don't know why I just know them. Who played with Sam Morgan then?
Well, Big Jim, Little Jim, Johnny Deve, Alfred Williams. Well they didn't have, Oilo Fusje, Andrew Morgan. How about eight men?
Did he have a second car now?
That's right, Young Morgan, his brother. Isil Morgan.
Which is Big Jim? Big Jim? Yeah, who is he?
Jim Robinson. I wanted you to tell me. Jim Robinson.
And Little Jim we know who that is. Sidney Brown. Did they have a piano in those kind of jobs?
Not at that particular time. They wasn't using any.
So when they'd play, I guess they wouldn't have a piano in the department stores up there on those balconies?
